control_flow.reason: Successful shallow array and object parses reach the selected print variant and dispatch to the corresponding changed function. The unreachable depth-1000 behaviors are assessed under their change IDs.

accepted.requirement: Make printing a constructible array tree at depth 1000 reachable by the read target.
accepted.target_route: Valid four-byte flags and NUL-terminated JSON → cJSON_ParseWithOpts → selected print variant → print_value → print_array.
accepted.failure_condition: Construct 1001 arrays and attach each as the previous array's child. Printing the root reaches the new depth-1000 rejection, but the target's parser rejects the 1001st array and returns NULL before any print call.

source_evidence.quote:
/* Limits how deeply nested arrays/objects can be before cJSON rejects to parse them.
 * This is to prevent stack overflows. */
#ifndef CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT
#define CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT 1000
#endif

mkdir build
cd build
cmake -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DENABLE_CJSON_TEST=OFF ..
make -j$(nproc)

$CXX $CXXFLAGS $SRC/cjson/fuzzing/cjson_read_fuzzer.c -I. \
    -o $OUT/cjson_read_fuzzer \
    $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE $SRC/cjson/build/libcjson.a

accepted.target_route: Valid four-byte flags and NUL-terminated JSON → cJSON_ParseWithOpts → selected print variant → print_value → print_object.
accepted.failure_condition: Construct 1001 objects with named child links. Printing the root reaches the new depth-1000 rejection, but the target's parser rejects the 1001st object and returns NULL before any print call.
accepted.alternative_paths: All three print choices receive the same parsed tree. Flag choices and trailing text cannot deepen it; optional minify edits a separate text copy after printing.
